en: Black‑and‑white view of a broad cobblestone street with a small fenced garden in the foreground. On the right stands a large three‑story neoclassical building with arched windows and a formal façade, likely a school or administrative building, fronted by trees and low fencing. On the left are several lower houses and, further down the street, a more ornate multi‑towered structure. People in early‑20th‑century dress walk along the street, and there are tall gas or early electric streetlamps. The scene is calm and urban, suggesting a European city boulevard.
